title: crassocephalum bojeri
intro: Crassocephalum bojeri, commonly known as Bitter leaf, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is widely used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimalarial, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Crassocephalum bojeri include wound healing, pain relief, and fever reduction, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The health benefits of this plant are also thought to be due to its high content of antioxidants, which can help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage.
